system_prompt:
Forecast daily recorded teleradiology study arrivals from synthetic history.
Use ONLY the supplied pre-origin daily summaries and requested dates and weekdays.
Recorded zeros and sparse days are not proven outages. Do not invent holidays,
timezones, hospitals, staffing or future observations. Predict each requested daily
point total directly; Python will allocate it to hours separately.
Return ONLY strict JSON: {"days":{"requested-date":nonnegative-number}}.
Use exactly response_dates as keys, without extra fields. An initial request has
up to two dates; retries may request only one. Copy dates exactly. Do not return
hourly predictions, quantiles, explanations or a combined total.
schema_policy: exact requested ISO date keys; strict envelope; independent daily numeric validation

allocation.history: all recorded pre-origin observations; no sparse-day exclusion
allocation.proportion: weekday/hour volume divided by total volume of that weekday
allocation.point: daily LLM point total times historical hourly proportion; not an hourly median

calibration.daily_residuals: 21 whole-day errors, independent of hourly bounds
calibration.bounds: nonnegative and containing the point; empirical, no coverage guarantee

evaluation_status: Exploratory: September outcomes were already inspected before designing this hybrid.
coherence: daily/hourly equality enforced by Python, not LLM arithmetic
